title: Kártyával vagy készpénzzel? Paying at Checkout

sections.title: How would you like to pay?
sections.content: fizet ("to pay") you already know from paying for a meal. At checkout, the question is Hogyan szeretne fizetni? ("How would you like to pay?"), and the answer names the method with -val/-vel: kártyával ("by card") or készpénzzel ("in cash"). Notice kártya keeps its á and just adds -val, while készpénz doubles its final z before -zel, the same assimilation you've already seen with vízzel.

Will you pay in cash or by card?

sections.content: készpénzzel looks intimidating with its double zz, but it's just the regular -vel rule: -vel copies the last consonant of the word it attaches to, so készpénz + vel becomes készpénzzel, exactly like víz + vel became vízzel.
